_comment: Weapons the prologue script names or implies.
Kept in their own catalog because weapons are attached to character hands
at runtime rather than being part of the character mesh, which is what makes
the promotion visuals in brief section 31 possible later.
Weapons are the clearest case of anime rule 5: a weapon is two materials
touching, so metal and wood are given two different hues rather than two
browns, which a two-band shader would collapse into one shape. 'Polished',
'rusty' and 'grain' are gone -- all three ask for a photograph.
